_comment: Top-level entries of the repository and the layer that owns each one. Keys are the names exactly as git reports them at depth 1 (directories without a trailing slash). Layer vocabulary: hot | settled | material | code | tooling | runtime | entry | deploy. Two layers hold knowledge (DEC-066): `hot` is read every session and must be true now, `settled` is on-disk history under knowledge/ and is read on demand. The doctrine behind this table is knowledge/wiki/guides/repository-layout.md.

.agent.purpose: 热层：每会话必读的事实（README 分层标准 / state / invariants / owners / handoffs 在飞票）

.claude.purpose: 项目级 agent 配置与 skills（含 speaking-dev）

backend.purpose: FastAPI 后端（app / migrations / tests / scripts）

docs.purpose: 只放工具按固定路径找的文件（agents/：技能配置）与物料（design/：设计稿、原型、发布图）

knowledge.purpose: 冷仓：一切记录过去的知识，入口是 knowledge/INDEX.md（wiki / adr / plans / progress / requirements / operations / archive / inbox / decisions+index / system-map / CHANGELOG）

logs.purpose: 本地运行产物，除 .gitkeep 与审计原始输出外不入库

AGENTS.md.purpose: agent 入口：路由表与强制规则

CLAUDE.md.purpose: Claude Code 入口重定向到 AGENTS.md

CONTEXT.md.purpose: 领域术语表（真身；每会话可读）

CONTRIBUTING.md.purpose: 贡献与提交流程（GitHub 自动识别）

nginx.conf.purpose: 开发/默认 nginx 站点

nginx.ssl.conf.purpose: 生产 nginx（TLS、安全头、日志脱敏）
